title: STeP-TS: Shared Temporal Filters with Pruning for Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2610.35128v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing temporal dependencies across multiple scales while accounting for both shared and variable-specific dynamics. Compact forecasting models have emerged as an attractive alternative to increasingly large architectures, but preserving strong predictive performance within tight computational and memory budgets remains challenging. We propose a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns a shared bank of multi-scale temporal filters of each variable. Lightweight variable-specific scalar weights determine the contribution of each temporal component, enabling the model to capture shared temporal structure while adapting to variable-specific dynamics. The learned weights and filter-output energy further provide a natural signal for structured pruning of convolutional filters, reducing computational complexity with minimal degradation in forecasting performance. translated_title: STeP-TS：面向时间序列的共享时间滤波器与剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列预测需要在多个尺度上捕捉时间依赖性，同时兼顾共享动态和变量特定动态。紧凑型预测模型已成为日益庞大的架构的一种有吸引力的替代方案，但在严格的计算和内存预算下保持强大的预测性能仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种紧凑的单层卷积框架，该框架为每个变量学习共享的多尺度时间滤波器库。轻量级的变量特定标量权重决定了每个时间分量的贡献，使模型能够在捕捉共享时间结构的同时适应变量特定的动态。学习到的权重和滤波器输出能量进一步为卷积滤波器的结构化剪枝提供了自然信号，在预测性能几乎不降低的情况下降低了计算复杂度。
tldr: 该论文提出STeP-TS紧凑单层卷积框架，通过共享多尺度时间滤波器库与轻量级变量特定标量权重实现多变量时间序列预测，并利用学习权重和滤波器输出能量作为信号进行结构化剪枝，在保持预测性能的同时显著降低计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: STeP-TS introduces a compact one-layer convolutional framework that learns shared multi-scale temporal filters with lightweight variable-specific scalar weights for multivariate time series forecasting, and leverages learned weights and filter-output energy for structured pruning to reduce computational complexity with minimal performance degradation.
